pairs: qui non intrat per ostium in ovile ovium,
he who does not enter through the door into the fold of the sheep,
but climbs up by another way,
he is a thief and a robber.
Qui autem intrat per ostium, pastor est ovium.
But he who enters through the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
and the sheep hear his voice,
and he calls his own sheep by name,
And when he has sent out his sheep,
But they do not follow a stranger;
because they do not know the voice of strangers.”
Jesus spoke this proverb to them.
illi autem non cognoverunt quid loqueretur eis.
But they did not understand what he was saying to them.
Therefore, Jesus spoke to them again:
that I am the door of the sheep.
and the sheep did not listen to them.
If anyone has entered through me,
Fur non venit nisi ut furetur, et mactet,
The thief does not come, except so that he may steal and slaughter and destroy.
et perdat. Ego veni ut vitam habeant,
I have come so that they may have life,
Bonus pastor animam suam dat pro ovibus suis.
The good Shepherd gives his life for his sheep.
and whoever is not a shepherd,
to whom the sheep do not belong,
and he departs from the sheep
because he is a hired hand
et non pertinet ad eum de ovibus.
and there is no concern for the sheep within him.
just as the Father knows me,
et animam meam pono pro ovibus meis.
And I lay down my life for my sheep.
And I have other sheep that are not of this fold,
quæ non sunt ex hoc ovili:
and there shall be one sheepfold
et fiet unum ovile et unus pastor.
For this reason, the Father loves me:
quia ego pono animam meam, ut iterum sumam eam.
because I lay down my life, so that I may take it up again.
No one takes it away from me.
sed ego pono eam a meipso,
Instead, I lay it down of my own accord.
And I have the power to lay it down.
et potestatem habeo iterum sumendi eam. Hoc mandatum accepi a Patre meo.
And I have the power to take it up again. This is the commandment that I have received from my Father.”
Dissensio iterum facta est inter Judæos propter sermones hos.
A dissension occurred again among the Jews because of these words.
Then many of them were saying:
Hæc verba non sunt dæmonium habentis:
“These are not the words of someone who has a demon.
numquid dæmonium potest cæcorum oculos aperire?
How would a demon be able to open the eyes of the blind?”
Facta sunt autem Encænia in Jerosolymis,
Now it was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem,
And Jesus was walking in the temple,
And so the Jews surrounded him
“How long will you hold our souls in suspense?
opera quæ ego facio in nomine Patris mei,
The works that I do in the name of my Father,
quia non estis ex ovibus meis.
because you are not of my sheep.
et ego vitam æternam do eis,
And I give them eternal life,
and they shall not perish, for eternity.
et non rapiet eas quisquam de manu mea.
And no one shall seize them from my hand.
Pater meus quod dedit mihi, majus omnibus est:
What my Father gave to me is greater than all,
et nemo potest rapere de manu Patris mei.
and no one is able to seize from the hand of my Father.
I and the Father are one.”
Therefore, the Jews took up stones,
Multa bona opera ostendi vobis ex Patre meo:
“I have shown you many good works from my Father.
propter quod eorum opus me lapidatis?
For which of those works do you stone me?”
De bono opere non lapidamus te,
“We do not stone you for a good work,
et quia tu homo cum sis,
Nonne scriptum est in lege vestra,
“Is it not written in your law,
Si illos dixit deos, ad quos sermo Dei factus est,
If he called those to whom the word of God was given gods,
et misit in mundum vos dicitis:
about him whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world,
Si non facio opera Patris mei,
If I do not do the works of my Father,
even if you are not willing to believe in me,
et credatis quia Pater in me est,
and believe that the Father is in me,
and I am in the Father.”
Therefore, they sought to apprehend him,
but he escaped from their hands.
And he went again across the Jordan,
in eum locum ubi erat Joannes baptizans primum,
to that place where John first was baptizing.
et multi venerunt ad eum, et dicebant:
And many went out to him. And they were saying:
Quia Joannes quidem signum fecit nullum.
Omnia autem quæcumque dixit Joannes de hoc, vera erant.
But all things whatsoever that John said about this man were true.”
